jobs.title: Regional Parking Data Analyst - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
LAZ Parking Regional Parking Data Analyst


Job Title \- Regional Parking Data Analyst



Job Summary



This position reports to regional leadership and partners closely with operations, finance, revenue management, technology, and asset management teams. The role supports a regional portfolio of on\-street and off\-street municipal parking operations and is expected to balance day\-to\-day reporting needs with strategic analysis for long\-term performance improvement.



The Regional Parking Data Analyst analyzes operational, financial, and utilization data across a portfolio of parking enforcement, meter collections, and paid parking facilities in the Los Angeles region. This role supports regional leadership by translating occupancy, revenue, customer behavior, officer productivity, asset performance, and operational efficiency data into clear recommendations. The analyst will work closely with the Business Intelligence team to develop dashboards, perform forecasting, identify revenue growth opportunities, and help drive consistent, data\-informed decision\-making across multiple locations.



Key Responsibilities



Regional Performance Analysis


* Analyze parking occupancy, utilization, turnover, and revenue trends across multiple on and off\-street facilities.


* Monitor regional KPIs, identify performance gaps and risks, and recommend actions that improve revenue, utilization, productivity, service performance, or operating efficiency.


* Provide operational and financial insights to Operations Managers and Senior Leadership.


* Conduct comparative analyses across locations to identify best practices and improvement opportunities.



Reporting \& Dashboard Development


* Support the development and maintenance of regional dashboards, scorecards, and client and executive reports.


* Automate recurring reports to improve efficiency and accuracy.


* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reviews that highlight trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended next steps.


* Create visualizations that clearly communicate trends, explain performance drivers, and support operational and financial decision\-making.



Revenue Management \& Forecasting


* Analyze revenue performance by facility, customer segment, permit type, parking product, daypart, and demand pattern to identify pricing, utilization, and revenue optimization opportunities.


* Monitor transient, event, contract, and monthly parking revenues.



Operations \& Utilization Analytics


* Evaluate occupancy patterns and peak\-demand periods, using GIS software.
* Assess facility capacity utilization and recommend operational improvements.


* Support dynamic pricing and yield management initiatives.


* Analyze staffing levels and labor productivity against facility demand.



Data Quality \& Systems Management


* Ensure accuracy and integrity of operational and financial reporting.


* Collaborate with IT and system vendors to improve reporting capabilities.


* Maintain data governance standards and reporting documentation.



Business Partnership \& Strategic Support


* Collaborate with Regional Operations, Finance, Sales, Revenue Management, and Asset Management teams.


* Present recommendations to regional leadership and corporate stakeholders.


* Support new facility onboarding by establishing baseline reporting, validating source data, and identifying early performance trends.


* Assist in evaluating business cases for technology investments and operational initiatives.



Education:


* Bachelor's Degree in Urban Planning, Operations Management, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or equivalent.


* Master's degree (MBA, Data Analytics, Finance, Statistics, or similar) preferred but not required.



Experience:


* 2 to 3\+ years of experience in one of the following:

o Data analysis



o Business intelligence



o Financial analysis



o Revenue management



o Operations analytics



o Project Management


* Experience working with multi\-site or regional operational portfolios preferred.
* Exposure to parking, transportation, mobility, facilities management, and municipal operations is highly desirable.
* Experience presenting findings to senior leadership and operational stakeholders.


* Able to learn and become proficient in other software applications, such as parking technology.


* Experience in overseeing technology and implementing initiatives that streamline existing processes using technology.

Data Analysis \& Reporting


* Advanced proficiency in:

o Microsoft Office 365, specifically Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced formulas)



o SQL



o Data modeling and analysis


* Strong experience with:

o Power BI



o Tableau



o Similar business intelligence platforms


* Ability to automate recurring reports and dashboards.


* Experience in trend analysis, KPI development, pricing analysis, scenario modeling.


* Ability to identify revenue optimization opportunities through data analysis.


* Experience with GIS platforms such as – ArcGIS, QGIS, GIS mapping tools.


* Ability to analyze utilization patterns geographically and identify demand trends.

Preferred Qualifications


* Parking industry experience.


* Knowledge of:

o Parking occupancy analytics



o Meter systems



o Enforcement operations



o Permit management



o Dynamic pricing strategies



Skills:


* Ability to seek improvement and create an environment of idea sharing and creative problem solving.


* Strong employee relations skills and abilities.


* Ability to be approachable and facilitate coaching conversations with employees and managers.


* Ability to mitigate and lead others to overcome challenges (Never Ever Give Up Attitude).


* Ability to encourage open expressions of ideas and opinions.


* Excellent teambuilding and interpersonal skills.


* Ability to work independently and multi\-task.


* Ability to communicate professionally and effectively with all levels of the organization,

jobs.title: Biological Field Technician
jobs.description:
**Job Title**Biological Field Technician
**Salary**27\.00 \- 29\.00
**Job Classification**Hourly
**Location**Tehachapi, CA 93561 US (Primary)  

**Job Type**Temporary
**\# of Hires Needed**1
**Application Deadline****Job Description**Western EcoSystems Technology, Inc. (WEST), a dynamic environmental and statistical consulting firm with offices across the United States and Canada, is looking for a temporary, full\-time, **Biological Field Technician,** in Tehachapi, California.

  


WEST has a permanent core of professionals with broad experience in basic and applied ecological studies and the sophisticated analysis of natural resource data. Since its founding in 1990, the WEST team has shaped the foundation of what we do, and what we believe in through our core values and key principles. Our work matters to our clients, communities, and the environment. Join WEST and discover a company of passionate, committed, and highly motivated individuals.

  


**Key Details:**


* **Compensation:** $27‒29/hr. commensurate with experience
* **Start date**: September 2026
* **End date:** October 2027
* **Location:** Tehachapi, California
* **Additional details:** Vehicle will be provided or mileage reimbursed. Company vehicles are equipped with telematics systems for safety, operational efficiency, and compliance purposes. GPS units and other field equipment will be provided by WEST; however, field technicians must be equipped with suitable footwear (rugged hiking boots).

  


**Job Description:** Primary duties will involve conducting eagle fatality monitoring at wind energy facilities. Fieldwork may require long days in often hot (often over 100° F) and windy conditions. Candidate must be comfortable with hazards typical of the desert environment (sharp vegetation, rattlesnakes, driving a four\-wheel drive vehicle, dust, extreme heat and cold). Job duties require use of compass, range\-finder, tablet, and Global Positioning System (GPS) devices. Training will be provided. An average work week may include 40 hours; however, shorter or longer hours may be necessary for some weeks, depending on the project and seasonal workloads.

  


*This is a general description of the functions for this position and is not inclusive of all duties which may be associated with this position.*

  



**Job Requirements****Requirements:**


* Bachelor’s Degree in Natural Resources, Wildlife Management, Wildlife Biology, or an equivalent degree preferred; undergraduates or other enthusiastic workers are encouraged to apply
* Highly proficient in identification of Mojave Desert bird species by sight and sound and able to work independently and interact positively with project manager, field supervisor, and other coworkers.
* Candidates experienced in field bird identification will be given preference.
* Employee must be able to appear for work on time (surveys often begin as early as sunrise), maintain focus for long periods of time, follow instructions from manager and team leader, maintain positive attitude, and accept guidance and constructive criticism. Precise and thorough data collection is essential.

  




**Physical Requirements:**


* Applicants must be in good physical condition, as surveys will require walking /hiking up to 8 miles each day over uneven terrain, and surveys will be conducted in locations where temperatures and wind can be extreme. Surveyors may encounter snakes, insects, and other wildlife.

  


*After an offer of employment is made, the candidate must successfully pass a pre\-employment background check, drug screening, and a DMV records check that meets WEST’s minimum criteria to operate a motor vehicle on behalf of the company. A valid driver’s license will be required.*

  


*WEST provides equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of their race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, genetics, and any protected veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Further, WEST takes affirmative action to ensure that all individuals are treated fairly, and without discrimination, for recruitment, selection, advancement and every other term and privilege associated with employment.*


**Education**Bachelor's Degree
**Salary Grade****Exemption Type**Non\-Exempt

jobs.title: Geologist
jobs.description:
**Geologist \- Seattle, WA**
============================

**Maul FosterAlongi, Inc. (MFA)** is seeking a **Project Geologist** to join our **Seattle** office. This is an exciting opportunity for a mid\-level geologist who thrives in the field, enjoys translating technical data into actionable insight, and is ready to take ownership of project tasks and client communication.

**As a Geologist,**


You won't just collect data; you'll help drive projects forward. As a Project Geologist, you'll play an important role in environmental investigations and remediation efforts, managing day\-to\-day activities and serving as a technical resource both in the field and in the office. Typical responsibilities include overseeing soil borings, monitoring well installation, groundwater and soil sampling, aquifer testing, and vapor or air sampling. You'll coordinate subcontractors, interact directly with clients and regulatory agencies, and help ensure that work is completed safely, on time, and within scope.


This role also includes office\-based work such as interpreting environmental data, evaluating subsurface and hydrogeologic conditions, and preparing clear, concise technical reports. You'll support the development of scopes, schedules, and cost estimates, while also mentoring junior staff and reviewing fieldwork for quality and accuracy. As part of MFA's team, you'll have the opportunity to strengthen client relationships, contribute to strategic project planning, and continue growing as a geoscience professional.

**To thrive in this role, you must have...**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in geology, hydrogeology, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in environmental consulting, with a mix of field and project responsibilities
* Licensed Geologist (LG) or the ability to obtain licensure within one year
* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER certification (preferred or obtainable upon hire).
* Proficiency in environmental field methods, including soil logging, well installation, sampling techniques, and field equipment use
* Familiarity with environmental regulations (e.g., MTCA, RCRA, CERCLA) and regulatory compliance expectations
* Strong data interpretation and technical writing skills, with experience developing remedial investigation reports or site characterization documents
* Comfort developing scopes of work, cost estimates, and project schedules
* Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
* A collaborative mindset with the initiative to lead field crews, mentor junior staff, and build relationships with clients
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook) or Google Suite.
* Valid driver's license and ability to maintain an acceptable driving record.

**Who we are...**


MFA is a multi\-disciplinary consulting company improving our communities through our work with our clients. We are employee\-owned and employee\-minded. Come join MFA for the benefits to your career, the benefits to your community and also our benefits package:

* 100% premium coverage for your medical/dental/vision and large percentage for your dependents
* Competitive paid time off plus nine paid holidays
* Comp time program for exempt employees
* Participation in the Employee Stock Ownership Plan
* 401k company match
* Support for your professional growth through coaching and external training support

**Why Seattle?**


Seattle offers the perfect balance of urban innovation and outdoor adventure. With stunning views of the Puget Sound, nearby mountain ranges, and endless hiking, biking, and kayaking opportunities, this city is an ideal place for those who love the environment\-both professionally and personally. Seattle is a hub for environmental innovation, making it an exciting place to work in environmental science and consulting. Beyond nature, the city boasts a thriving culture, excellent food, and a strong sense of community.

**Our hiring process for this position**

* Initial Conversation with Human Resources
* Interview with Hiring Manager
* Interview with the Team
* Writing test


Compensation for hire: **$83,200 to $95,800**


Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

*Here at MFA, we celebrate diversity and actively encourage women, people of color, LGBTQ\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.*

*MFA is a proud equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are based on job requirements, business needs, and individual qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military service, or any other status protected by laws and regulations.*
